limitations.text: Cannot establish semantic precision: an audit pass means declared counts equal row counts and labels; it cannot show any row is a true execution, that 'observed' rows are not data-only false positives (verifier spotcheck:69-81 frozenset counterexample), or that the r19 helper-lead precision harm is repaired.
Cannot establish independent admission: the audit is lane-authored lane-local evidence; admission requires outside-lane falsification and the non-author integrator.
basis: .ufo/waves/round-22/registration.md:7 ('Artifact assertions are not authenticated authorship, semantic truth or outside-lane approval.')

limitations.text: Evidence labels are self-asserted by the snapshot producer; the audit checks label/count consistency, not that the producer assigned the tier correctly.
The r19 rejected-harmed verdict stands; a C2 red on the r19 receipt is a disclosure finding, not a re-grade of r19.

unresolved_for_planner.text: Counting unit: the C3 receipt is line-level (6 incident lines: 5 observed + 1 lead) while the scan receipt is row-level (11 finding rows: 10 on the five observed lines, 1 on r13-root:4). The contract's claim.total counts snapshot findings rows, so 'five observed plus one lead' matches only a line-level representation. Which unit the faithful r19 fixture uses is not fixed by registration or contract.

Faithful representation vs schema: tw-recall-after.txt rows lack class, command and evidence; scan rows lack evidence. Under the contract a row without class/command or with missing evidence is uncertainty/invalid, which may make an unchanged-row r19 snapshot evaluate as 2 (could-not-evaluate) rather than 1 (failed/red), and makes the 'green when scoped to five observed plus one lead' case unreachable unless labels are added, which changes rows. The planner must declare whether representation may add an evidence key and where the 5/1 split authority comes from (verifier spotcheck:63, not the detector).

The contract has no distinct finding id for an observed-claimed lead beyond observed_count_mismatch/lead_count_mismatch; whether a missing-marker row adds to lead, to an uncertainty bucket, or forces code 2 is unspecified.
